type UseBaseMutationResult<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError, TVariables = unknown, TOnMutateResult = unknown> = Override<OmitKeyof<MutationObserverResult<TData, TError, TVariables, TOnMutateResult>, "context">, {
  mutate: UseMutateFunction<TData, TError, TVariables, TOnMutateResult>;
}>;

Defined in: [packages/solid-query/src/types.ts:304](https://github.com/TanStack/query/blob/main/packages/solid-query/src/types.ts#L304)

The result of `useMutation`. Same as [MutationObserverResult](MutationObserverResult.md) from `@tanstack/query-core`, with
`mutate` replaced by the promise-returning [UseMutateFunction](UseMutateFunction.md).

## Type Parameters

### TData

`TData` = `unknown`

The type your `mutationFn` resolves to.

### TError

`TError` = [`DefaultError`](DefaultError.md)

The type of errors your `mutationFn` may throw.

### TVariables

`TVariables` = `unknown`

The type of the variable passed to `mutate`.

### TOnMutateResult

`TOnMutateResult` = `unknown`

The type returned by `onMutate`, passed to `onSuccess`/`onError`/`onSettled` as
their `onMutateResult` parameter — useful for optimistic-update rollback data.
